name: free.calculator/mcp
title: Calculator.Free
description: Find 200+ calculators and run them with the same formulas as the website

tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Find calculators by name or topic (for example "mortgage", "BMI", "percent change", "kg to lb"), optionally within one category, or list every calculator in a category. Returns the slug, name, short description, category, whether calculate can run it, and the page link.

lang.description: Language for names, labels and method text, an ISO code such as en, es, de, ja (default en).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The calculator categories, with a description and how many calculators each has.

lang.description: Language for names, labels and method text, an ISO code such as en, es, de, ja (default en).

tools.name: get_calculator
tools.description: One calculator's details as its page states them: what it computes, the method or formula text, every input with its unit, default, limits and options, the results it returns, modes, supported countries for tax and currency calculators, its FAQ and the page link.

slug.description: Calculator slug (from search_calculators), page link or name.

country.description: For tax and currency aware calculators: us, uk, ca, au, in, ie, nz or za (default us).

lang.description: Language for names, labels and method text, an ISO code such as en, es, de, ja (default en).

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run a calculator with the website's own formulas and return its results, the inputs used (omitted inputs take their default, listed in defaults_applied), any table it builds (for example an amortization schedule) and the page link. Input keys and option values come from get_calculator. Calls count toward the same limits as the calculator API: an hourly limit per network address, or the account API key quota when the signed in account has a key.

slug.description: Calculator slug, page link or name.

inputs.description: Input key to value, for example {"price": 350000, "rate": 6.5, "years": 30}. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

mode.description: Mode key, for calculators that have modes.

country.description: For tax and currency aware calculators (default us).

lang.description: Language for names, labels and method text, an ISO code such as en, es, de, ja (default en).
